roles.purpose: Read-only primary coordinator that uses the minimum sufficient team
use_when: coordination is primary and direct repository mutation should remain delegated
do_not_use_when: clear work is better completed directly by working-manager

roles.purpose: Directly completes small and medium work, delegating only when material
use_when: clear work can be completed directly with bounded delegation when needed
do_not_use_when: the configured primary policy explicitly requires read-only manager coordination

roles.purpose: Implements scoped changes and produces test and behavior evidence
use_when: scoped implementation or correction requires repository mutation
do_not_use_when: the task is review-only, exploration-only, or architecture-only

roles.purpose: Read-only architecture, contract, and data-model design specialist
use_when: architecture or contract design materially changes a subsystem or durable boundary
do_not_use_when: local implementation can proceed without architecture judgment

roles.purpose: Maps only the repository context needed for the current decision
use_when: repository scope, ownership, symbols, or dependencies are materially uncertain
do_not_use_when: required repository context is already known and fresh

roles.purpose: Independently reviews diffs, tests, and acceptance criteria for regressions
use_when: material regression or independent quality review is required
do_not_use_when: deterministic low-risk evidence is sufficient without an independent reviewer

roles.purpose: Reviews real security-boundary changes through data flow and authority
use_when: a material security, trust, credential, permission, input, supply-chain, or external-action boundary changed

roles.purpose: Verifies UI changes with browser, responsive, console, and network evidence
use_when: UI, CSS, DOM, rendering, accessibility, or visual interaction materially changed
